_doc: Edit decision list for the Get Ready recap. Times are source seconds. 'beats' sets a duration in music beats instead of an out point. audio: dia = dialogue at full level, amb = natural sound at low level under music, mute = picture only. layout: native (1080x1920 source, optional zoom), wide (4K laptop shot, full frame), screen (punch-in on the laptop screen over a blurred fill), endcard (blurred, darkened background for the closing title). cx/cy = centre of the stream picture in 4K source pixels.

segments.why: Most striking frame: Mavriq speaker on yellow, live session preview
CACEIS speaker preview, a second partner company
Two-speaker panel preview; establishes 'real sessions' before the promo story
'E la novita si chiama Get Ready, quindi tra settembre/ottobre ci saranno 15 appuntamenti con aziende diverse' - names the campaign and states what it is
Tech & Data ad opening hook: 'Se vuoi lavorare nel mondo tech e dei dati'
Finance ad, same script structure: shows the campaign was tailored per vertical. '...ma inviare CV a vuoto non sta funzionando, ascolta qui.'
'Non serve tirare a indovinare cosa cercano i recruiter.' - the campaign promise
'Dal 17 settembre su Joinrs te lo diranno direttamente gli HR di grandi aziende' - who and when
'...come CACEIS, AMCO e Allianz Trade.' Punch-in on the named partners; continuous audio
'E gratis e ti daremo anche un attestato per il tuo CV.' - the benefit
'Ogni settimana saremo in diretta su Zoom per esplorare ruoli come il Bank Analyst' - the promise of the live sessions; cuts straight into the Bank Analyst session
